findings.summary: The multiline flow check counts brackets inside YAML comments as closing delimiters, allowing invalid frontmatter to pass strict checking.
findings.failure_scenario:
A command containing `---
description: Inspect changes
allowed-tools: [
  Read
  # ]
---
` has an unclosed YAML list, but concatenation produces `[ Read # ]` and bad_flow_collection treats the commented bracket as the closing delimiter. Consequently, `check --kind command --strict` succeeds although the frontmatter cannot parse; the pre-change check rejected it.
findings.fix: Preserve continuation-line boundaries and make the flow scanner skip YAML comments outside quoted values before counting delimiters. Add a strict-check regression where the only closing bracket is commented out.

resolution: medium fixed in the next commit
